quality.review_scope: Independent root source and apparatus audit passed for all three supplied main pages, six figures and the 28-reference bibliography. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Full supplied three-page main only; local SI not located or verified and cited full sources unreviewed.

Stock-solution solvent, stock preparation order, individual nitrate charges, hydration states, heating ramps, pressure, cooling details, filter specification, wash doses/repetitions, drying duration/pressure and storage are not reported.
The source prints 92 mol% ZrO(NO3)2 and 16 mol% Sc(NO3)3 as nominal feed composition. These are retained literally, not normalized to a sum of 100 or confused with 8 mol% Sc2O3 oxide composition.
The Figure 3 series uses 80 °C for 24 h then 180 °C for 48 h. It must not inherit the 48 h + 72 h schedule of Figures 1, 2a, 4, 5 and 6.
Only the 0.05 mol/L cation / 0.2 mol/L urea long-schedule specimen has the text-reported TEM, XRD and BET sizes. No approximate graph coordinates are converted to exact measurements.
No atomic coordinates, refined unit cell, measured conductivity or sintering-performance dataset is supplied. Molecular/specimen and apparatus graphics are illustrative; presentation pending.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
conflicts: At 0.5 mol/L urea, main p. 1 says pure cubic for ≤0.5 mol/L, while the conclusion says <0.5 mol/L. Figure 2a also shows a small nonzero monoclinic point at 0.5 mol/L. Preserve the boundary uncertainty, without an exact digitized fraction.

The general method gives urea concentrations 0.1–1.5 mol/L; Figure 3 includes 0.5 mol/L cations at a cation:urea ratio of 1:4, which implies a value outside that general range. Retain the explicit cation setting and ratio without silently changing either statement.
